newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Dean Foods EPS view raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Dean Foods EPS view raised.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said on Friday it raised its 1997 earnings-per-share estimate for Dean Foods Inc to $1.95 from $1.85 and its 1998 EPS estimate to $2.15 from $2.05.
-- The firm increased its estimates after Dean Foods Co reported fiscal second-quarter earnings that exceeded analysts' forecasts.
-- EVEREN also raised its price objectives on the stock to $31 from $30 for six months and to $32 from $31 for the 18 months.
--Dean Foods was 1-3/8 higher at 30-3/4 in late afternoon trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
